method: evaluated the published closed form (TP A-28 p.2, the MathCAD formulation of TP A-14 Eqs. 15-17) at the published parameters and the published plot grid; the calibration rows are transcribed from TP B-3 p.2 rather than read off a plot

friction_a28.origin: TP A-28 p.1, fitted to Marlow (1995) Table 10

friction_b3.origin: TP B-3 p.2, refitted to the calibration data

error_estimate.model_points: exact evaluation; no digitization error. The uncertainty is the parameters': TP A-28's friction fit is a 3-point fit to Marlow's data, and ball-cloth/ball condition moves mu_b between roughly 0.03 and 0.08 (issue #3 constants table)
error_estimate.measurement_points: TP B-3 publishes no uncertainty for the calibration values; it prints only the six measured numbers and a least-squares refit whose residual we report here
error_estimate.printed_degree_column_caveat: TP B-3's printed degrees differ from atan(inches_per_yard/36) by about 0.6-1%; use the inches-per-yard column and convert
